# دارایی‌ها — Asset inventory

**Generated by `content_tools/asset_report.py`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every image and sound the shipped chapter data references, and whether the
file exists in this repository yet. A row marked ❌ has no file: the game
falls back to a clearly-marked placeholder for images, and to an estimated
reading time with a visible «صدای این خط هنوز ضبط نشده است» notice for
voice lines. Neither fallback is a deliverable.

### What IS in the repository

- **Vazirmatn** (SIL OFL 1.1), the Persian typeface, with its licence.
- **The player avatar and the whole cast**, drawn as original vector art
  in `scripts/ui/avatar_portrait.gd` and `scripts/ui/character_figure.gd`.
  These are real, parametric and consistent at any size — not placeholders —
  though hand-painted sheets would replace them for the shipping look.
- **The app icon**, an original mark in `assets/art/ui/icon.svg`.

### Background specification

```
Format WebP (fall back to PNG), sRGB. Two sizes per background:
2048x1152 for tablets and 1280x720 for phones; the engine letterboxes
between aspect ratios rather than cropping the important part of the
scene. Painted in the style fixed in docs/ART_DIRECTION.md: 2D painted
with clean edges and soft shading, warm palette for safe places and a
cooler, more contrasted palette for mystery locations.
```

### Voice specification

```
Ogg Vorbis, mono, 44.1 kHz, target -16 LUFS, room tone trimmed to
under 150 ms at both ends. One file per line id. The same voice must play a
character across all ten chapters.
```
